title: 49ers' George Kittle pushing for ‘realistic' Week 1 return from Achilles injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers' George Kittle pushing for ‘realistic' Week 1 return from Achilles injury
sources.description: Playing in front of over 100,000 Australian NFL fans on Sept. 10 is motivating San Francisco 49ers star George Kittle during his Achilles rehab.
